producer_checks.information_cutoff: 17 Nov 01:30 BRT / 04:30 UTC. Market figures are from 16 Nov. Nvidia results, Eurostat final HICP and Fed minutes are scheduled, not observed.
producer_checks.novelty: Adds the US/Asia equity close, Monday’s Treasury curve and energy repricing, euro-area industrial production, and the IBC-Br and Focus data released after the previous edition’s cutoff.
producer_checks.bilingual_parity: Both editions use the same 14 sources, chart values, periods, hypotheses and falsifiers.
producer_checks.visual_evidence: Two sourced charts, market/Focus/scenario tables, a regional exposure map and two conditional financing mechanisms.

limitations: Equity returns refer to local sessions with different closing times and structures.
Treasury yields do not identify movements in private credit spreads or the term premium.
Focus responses precede the IBC-Br release and the monthly/quarterly activity measures are not the IBGE GDP series.
October euro-area inflation is a flash estimate at the cutoff.
contrary_evidence: US Treasury yields fell while stocks fell, limiting an explanation based on rising sovereign rates that day.
Quarterly Brazilian activity weakened while its year-on-year comparison remained positive.
Euro-area industry rose on the month but contracted year on year.

en.title: Global Macro — Chip stocks slide as Brazil’s activity weakens and inflation expectations rise
en.deck: US chip stocks fell 5.3% even as Treasury yields eased. In Brazil, the IBC-Br contracted in the third quarter and the Focus survey’s 2027 inflation median reached 5.00%.
en.regime: Pressure on technology valuations despite a small decline in US sovereign yields, alongside softer Brazilian activity and higher inflation expectations.
en.key_risk: Tighter private financing and exchange-rate pass-through could offset lower sovereign yields and crude prices.
watch: Brazil services inflation and lending terms

pt-BR.title: Global Macro — Ações de chips recuam enquanto o Brasil perde ritmo e a inflação esperada sobe
pt-BR.deck: As ações americanas de semicondutores caíram 5,3% mesmo com o recuo dos juros dos Treasuries. No Brasil, o IBC-Br caiu no trimestre e o Focus indicou IPCA de 5,00% para 2027.
pt-BR.regime: Pressão sobre as ações de tecnologia com leve queda de juros soberanos nos EUA, atividade brasileira mais fraca e inflação esperada mais alta.
pt-BR.key_risk: Crédito privado mais caro e repasse cambial podem limitar o alívio de juros soberanos e petróleo mais baixos.
